hooks.command: B="${AGENT_BOT_BIN:-agent-bot}"; command -v "$B" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "agent-bot is not installed — install agent-bot-identity" >&2; exit 127; }; exec "$B" claude-worktree-create
hooks.statusMessage: Creating worktree with its bot identity…

hooks.command: H="${AGENT_BOT_HOOK_BIN:-$HOME/.local/share/agent-bot/agent-hook}"; [ -x "$H" ] || exit 0; exec "$H" --dialect claude --event session-start # agent-bot agent-hook
H="${AGENT_BOT_HOOK_BIN:-$HOME/.local/share/agent-bot/agent-hook}"; [ -x "$H" ] || exit 0; exec "$H" --dialect claude --event session-end # agent-bot agent-hook
H="${AGENT_BOT_HOOK_BIN:-$HOME/.local/share/agent-bot/agent-hook}"; [ -x "$H" ] || exit 0; exec "$H" --dialect claude --event prompt-submit # agent-bot agent-hook
H="${AGENT_BOT_HOOK_BIN:-$HOME/.local/share/agent-bot/agent-hook}"; [ -x "$H" ] || exit 0; exec "$H" --dialect claude --event pre-tool-use # agent-bot agent-hook
H="${AGENT_BOT_HOOK_BIN:-$HOME/.local/share/agent-bot/agent-hook}"; [ -x "$H" ] || exit 0; exec "$H" --dialect claude --event pre-command # agent-bot agent-hook
H="${AGENT_BOT_HOOK_BIN:-$HOME/.local/share/agent-bot/agent-hook}"; [ -x "$H" ] || exit 0; exec "$H" --dialect claude --event pre-file-write # agent-bot agent-hook
H="${AGENT_BOT_HOOK_BIN:-$HOME/.local/share/agent-bot/agent-hook}"; [ -x "$H" ] || exit 0; exec "$H" --dialect claude --event post-tool-use # agent-bot agent-hook
H="${AGENT_BOT_HOOK_BIN:-$HOME/.local/share/agent-bot/agent-hook}"; [ -x "$H" ] || exit 0; exec "$H" --dialect claude --event agent-stop # agent-bot agent-hook
